summary: Tested image upload bug fix. All 13 tests passed. The fix correctly changed the upload path from /backend/routes/uploads/ to /backend/uploads/ (using UPLOAD_DIR from config.py). HEIC to JPEG conversion working. File size limit (10MB) enforced. Invalid file types rejected. Uploaded files are accessible via GET /api/uploads/{filename}.
seed_data_creation: Test images uploaded during testing (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC converted to JPG)

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Image uploads not working ('nu merge sa incarc poze')
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Upload saved files to /backend/routes/uploads/ but static file serving was from /backend/uploads/
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Changed public.py line 90 to use UPLOAD_DIR from config.py instead of os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'uploads')
